import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import type { NavigationItem } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { SurfaceController } from '../../controllers/surface-controller.js';
export declare class MainMenu extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        currentId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        expandedId: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultExpandedId: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        mobileOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultMobileOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        query: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        mobileVariant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        narrow: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        embedded: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        mobileTriggerId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        mobileTriggerLabel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
    };
    items: readonly NavigationItem[];
    currentId: string;
    expandedId: string | null | undefined;
    defaultExpandedId: string | null | undefined;
    mobileOpen: boolean | undefined;
    defaultMobileOpen: boolean | undefined;
    query: string | undefined;
    mobileVariant: 'simple' | 'sections' | 'drilldown';
    private narrow;
    embedded: boolean;
    mobileTriggerId: string;
    mobileTriggerLabel: string;
    private media?;
    private expanded;
    private mobile;
    private queryState;
    private queryComposing;
    private queryDraft;
    private branchReturn?;
    readonly surface: SurfaceController;
    constructor();
    get committedExpanded(): string | null;
    get committedMobile(): boolean;
    private get committedQuery();
    private path;
    private expand;
    private collapse;
    private showMobile;
    private containsBranch;
    private editQuery;
    private list;
    private escape;
    private resize;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    updated(): void;
    private content;
    render(): TemplateResult<1>;
}
